Chesapeake Bay from Sandy Point to North Beach-
656 PM EST Sun Nov 8 2026

...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH MONDAY EVENING...

.TONIGHT...SW winds 15 kt...becoming W after midnight. Gusts up to
25 kt. Waves 2 ft. 
.MON...NW winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. 
.MON NIGHT...NW winds 10 to 15 kt. Gusts up to 20 kt until early
morning. Waves 1 to 2 ft. 
.TUE...SW winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.TUE NIGHT...W winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.WED...W winds 5 kt. Waves less than 1 ft. 
.WED NIGHT...SE winds 5 to 10 kt. Waves 1 ft. 
.THU...SE winds 10 kt...becoming SW 15 to 20 kt in the evening, then
becoming NW 20 to 25 kt after midnight. Waves 2 to 3 ft. Rain likely
in the afternoon. A chance of rain through the night. 
.FRI...NW winds 25 to 30 kt. Waves 3 ft. A chance of rain.
